title: The Lamp Room
setting: A lighthouse on a rock, one night before the supply boat leaves

victim.name: Edda Marsh
victim.summary: Head keeper, found dead at the foot of the lamp-room stairs.

brief: Edda Marsh kept the light for thirty years. At dawn she was found at the foot of the tower stairs, neck broken. The rail rope at the top hangs loose. Three people were on the rock.

suspects.name: Orin Vale
suspects.relation: Worked under Edda for four years
suspects.alibi: Says he slept in the bunk room all night.

suspects.name: Maren Pike
suspects.relation: Brings stores to the rock each month
suspects.alibi: Says she stayed aboard her boat until dawn.

suspects.name: Dax Holloway
suspects.alibi: Says he worked on his report in the guest room.

items.title: Who held the tower key
items.body: Edda, Orin and the inspector each had a key. The boat crew had none, but the tower door was found unlocked.

lines.a: In my bunk. The wind kept me up, but I never left.
A thump near midnight. I thought it was the shutters.

lines.q: When did you leave the tower?
lines.a: Before ten. I only brought the stores up.
She seemed angry. She said she had written to the Board.
We argued about her logs at supper. Nothing more.
In the guest room. My lamp burned until one.

sections.heading: Cause
sections.body: Broken neck from a fall of about nine metres.

sections.heading: Hands
sections.body: Tarred rope fibres under the nails of both hands.

sections.heading: Rail
sections.body: The top rail rope was cut clean, not frayed.

sections.heading: Door
sections.body: Tower door unlocked from outside. No force used.

items.caption: Edda lay at the foot of the stairs. A coil of rope lies beside her.

items.title: Cut rope end
items.body: A short length of tarred rope, cut with a sharp blade. It matches the rail rope and smells of the boat yard.

items.title: Edda's draft letter
items.body: To the Board: I have found crates landed at night that are not on any manifest. The skipper must answer for them before the next boat.

items.title: Supply manifest
items.body: Eleven crates of stores logged. Dock count at the jetty: fourteen. The skipper signed for all fourteen.

rows.text: Supper in the keeper's room. Edda and the inspector argue.
Inspector goes to the guest room. Lamp lit until one.
Orin's bunk-room door is heard to close.
A thump is heard from the tower.
Edda found at the foot of the stairs.

items.title: The rock
items.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 120" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="120" fill="#0B1215"/><rect x="80" y="30" width="40" height="60" fill="none" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M0 100 q50 -10 80 -10 M120 90 q40 0 80 10" stroke="#3B8EEA" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/><circle cx="170" cy="96" r="5" fill="#00FFB3"/><text x="150" y="112" fill="#00FFB3" font-size="7">JETTY</text><text x="86" y="62" fill="#E5E5E5" font-size="7">TOWER</text></svg>
items.caption: The tower stands between the bunk room and the jetty where the boat lies.

items.title: Weather note
items.body: Fog came in at eleven. A boat at the jetty could not be seen from the guest room window.

motives.text: She stood to inherit Edda's pension.
Edda was about to report her smuggling.

methods.text: Pushed her down the stairs by hand.
Cut the rail rope so it gave way.
Struck her with a lamp wrench.
